title: Email format switches change only what they name in every real send, keep the unsubscribe link, and the Setup card saves exactly the five fields
steps: Run the send ledger suite against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) with fake Google and fake aMember, and the mounted harness flow suite, from this branch.
expect: With no setting row, the format reads as the defaults and a test send carries List-Unsubscribe-Post, a Message-ID on the Tracy host and the notice footer.

With all five switched: no List-Unsubscribe header, Message-ID on joomlart.com, the personal footer with a working unsubscribe link, no title element, a div dir=ltr wrapper, and a customer invitation without the open image; exactly one mail_format_setting audit row.
The Setup card reads the format, keeps Save disabled until a change, and posts exactly the five fields.
fence: Fake Google and fake aMember only; no credential, no real mailbox, no customer address.

tests: Email format: every switch changes only what it names, for tests and invitations alike
Setup › Email format reads the server format and saves exactly the five switches
